subject: Request: latest penetration test report and secure transfer options
messages:
From: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@acme-media.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-media.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest penetration test and secure delivery options

Hi Rishi,

We are preparing our SIG submission and need the most recent penetration test report that covers the hosted API (production). Can you share the latest PT report and a short summary of any high/critical findings and whether they have been remediated or are in progress?

Additionally, legal wants the report delivered over a secure channel — can you outline the transfer options you support (S3 presigned link, secure evidence portal, SFTP, or direct SharePoint link) and any access controls (passwords, link expiry, IP restriction) you can apply?

Our timeline is tight: ideally we need the artifacts and a remediation status summary by end of week (Fri 7/25). Please let me know what you can provide and any prerequisites from our side (NDA, account we need to whitelist, etc.).

Thanks,
Mike
Mike Jackson
Security Engineer, Acme Media
security@acme-media.com

---
Note: If easier, we can accept a redacted PDF and a short CSV of open CVEs.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@acme-media.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test and secure delivery options

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answer: we can provide a redacted penetration test report (PDF) plus a remediation matrix (spreadsheet) that maps findings to ticket/PR and status. We support three secure transfer methods:

- Secure Evidence Portal: Single sign-on (Okta SAML) access for your security team. Link is time-bound and requires your email to be invited. Access is audit-logged.
- Expiring S3 presigned bundle: password-protected zip available for 72 hours by default; we can shorten or lengthen expiry, and optionally restrict by IP range for your CI/CD IPs.
- SFTP drop: client key auth; we provision a short-lived account and push artifacts to your directory.

We generally require a mutual NDA for full, unredacted reports. For redacted reports we can usually share after acceptance of our standard security evidence request form. If you need raw test artifacts (PoCs), we will require both NDA and a brief statement of intended use.

For timelines: Monica (cc'd) owns the delivery ops — Monica, can we target redacted PDF + remediation matrix by Fri 7/25 EOD PST using the presigned S3 bundle? If Mike confirms S3 is fine and whether IP restriction is needed, we'll kick off prep.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: security-evidence-request-form.pdf (fillable), internal-remediation-summary-template.xlsx
From: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@acme-media.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-media.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test and secure delivery options

Thanks, Rishi. Presigned S3 bundle works for us as long as it's password-protected and expires within 48 hours. We don't need raw PoCs.

Two quick asks:
- Could you include a one-paragraph remediation summary that explicitly calls out any open findings with severity >= High and an estimated ETA to close?
- Legal will want a redaction indicator (which sections were removed) — a brief note in the delivery email is sufficient.

If you can confirm those, we'll be ready for the download. No NDA required for a redacted report.

Mike
